status: authoring-reference; provisional operating assumptions, not authoritative game state

units.time: simulation hours or days; never wall-clock offline depletion

berths.main_bay_mode: internal ship OR external freight transfer

supplies.reserve_condition: Sealed, isolated occupied room; a hull breach or failed circulation changes the outcome. Not an EVA duration.

power.policy: Variable stellar flux, orientation and damage reduce generation. Shed workshop loads before protected life-support reserve. No repair or drive activation gates implemented.

thermal.policy: Provisional game rating at a reference thermal condition; radiator temperature, shadow and damage require later simulation tuning.

connected_in_current_geometry: plant to gallery, hub, commons, workshop and habitation
solar sealed feedthrough to plant power bus
plant process-heat loop to exterior thermal cassette
not_yet_complete: bay, stores and dock branch feeds
individual berth air outlets and emergency bottle changeover
internal circuitry and fluid passages inside equipment
pressure-wall machining beyond the abstracted sealed fittings
process-loop disconnects and thermal cassette-removal choreography with these new lines

limits: Proposed tuneable fictional ratings; not inferred from mesh volume, flow analysis or structural calculations.
Character animation, runtime atmosphere/power/pressure/economy and procedural station generation are not implemented here.
The current reference is a single occupied state; source mechanism clips still require independent normalized packaging.
The code session must keep simulation and persistent state application-owned in C++; Godot consumes that state.
